scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter '!@workspace/mockup-sandbox' --filter '!@workspace/update-admin' --filter '!@workspace/avarpus-web' --filter '!@workspace/mobile' --if-present run build && PORT=4173 BASE_PATH=/__mockup pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run build && PORT=4174 BASE_PATH=/update-admin/ pnpm --filter @workspace/update-admin run build && VITE_API_URL=${VITE_API_URL:-https://build-validation.invalid} BASE_PATH=/avarpus-web/ pnpm --filter @workspace/avarpus-web run build && EXPO_METRO_PORT=18081 pnpm --filter @workspace/mobile run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
